metadata.title: Shared Mailbox SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining trust boundaries, authority, accountability, and data-handling constraints for shared and functional email mailboxes.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, records, and regulatory baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional shared email mailboxes used for functional communication (e.g., service desks, departments, programs) by multiple authorized human operators.

information-type.title: Shared Email Message Content
information-type.description: Email content sent to or from a shared mailbox acting as a functional communication endpoint.

information-type.title: Shared Mailbox Metadata
information-type.description: Sender identity, delegation state, message status, and audit correlation metadata for shared mailboxes.

information-type.title: Delegation and Access Records
information-type.description: Records of who is authorized to access, send, or manage the shared mailbox and for what duration.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Shared Mailbox Service inherits all Individual Email SSPP constraints unless explicitly overridden.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Shared Mailbox Service is implemented on the Secure Email Platform.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: Shared mailboxes are intended for functional, role-based communication by authorized human operators.

props.name: identity-scope
props.remarks: A shared mailbox represents a function or service, not an individual person.

props.name: volume-constraint
props.remarks: Shared mailboxes MUST NOT be used for bulk, mass, or campaign-style messaging.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: Shared mailboxes MUST NOT be used as application inboxes or automated message processors.

props.name: external-forwarding
props.remarks: External forwarding is prohibited for shared mailboxes under all circumstances.

props.name: delegation-model
props.remarks: Access to shared mailboxes MUST be explicitly granted based on institutional role and approved purpose.

props.name: delegation-duration
props.remarks: Delegated access to shared mailboxes MUST be time-bound and periodically reviewed.

props.name: mailbox-ownership
props.remarks: Each shared mailbox MUST have an explicitly assigned organizational owner accountable for governance and lifecycle.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All actions taken via a shared mailbox MUST be attributable to the individual operator performing them.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Shared mailboxes MUST NOT be used to transmit or store information classified at Level 4 or higher.

props.name: information-use-constraint
props.remarks: Shared mailboxes are not authorized as long-term repositories for records or documents.

props.name: disclosure-authority
props.remarks: Disclosure of shared mailbox content occurs only under lawful or formally authorized institutional processes.

props.name: external-correspondence-constraint
props.remarks: Official correspondence via shared mailboxes MUST use institutional email addresses only.

props.name: access-model
props.remarks: Shared and role-based mailboxes do not support direct login or authentication; all access occurs via delegated Send-As or Send-On-Behalf.

system-implementation.remarks: Shared mailbox trust is enforced through explicit delegation, per-user attribution, centralized monitoring, and retention controls.

components.title: Shared Email Mailbox
components.description: Functional mailbox accessed by multiple authorized operators with enforced attribution and audit logging.

roles.title: Shared Mailbox Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for the purpose, delegation approvals, reviews, and lifecycle of the shared mailbox.

roles.title: Shared Mailbox Operator
roles.remarks: Authorized individual acting on behalf of the shared mailbox function.

control-implementation.remarks: All controls applicable to shared mailboxes are inherited from the Individual Email SSPP and Secure Email Platform SSPP with additional delegation and audit constraints.
